Nine paraphrases come from one conversation; the team proposes random-row 80/20 development/test allocation. Define criteria, uncertainty, independent review/adjudication and split handling without inventing authoritative rules or human sign-off.
criteria: Keep L1 final-state correctness unresolved rather than fabricate a verified outcome
Do not settle L2 policy validity from an unversioned snippet or reviewer preference

Keep related paraphrases/conversation in one data split
Provide explicit labeling criteria, examples and preserved independent/adjudicated records
